name: Emberhand
body:
School evocation [fire, light]; Level druid 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, witch 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Target creature or creatures touched (up to one/level)

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

Your hand becomes surrounded in glowing motes and sparks or a color you choose. These motes illuminate like a candle, though it produces no heat and cannot ignite objects until the spell is discharged. Each touch channels fiery light that deals 1d8 points of fire damage +1 per level.
